items.title: D&D Duel
items.description: Nicknamed 'Andrey Duelos', this is a Dungeons & Dragons-based RPG card game where the goal is to win duels using 3 cards against the system to score points. Developed by a team of 4, my main contribution was building most of the frontend (Next.js and Tailwind CSS), alongside backend tasks (Spring Boot) and PostgreSQL configuration. The app consumes the official API <https://www.dnd5eapi.co/> and the architecture is orchestrated via Docker Compose. The link below provides access to the main repository containing the services.

items.title: FitForge
items.description: A B2B management system for gyms, focused on controlling students, workouts, and exercises. Developed for small and medium-sized businesses, it offers an intuitive interface for managers to centrally and efficiently organize operations. The provided link leads to a practical demonstration of how the system would work in a gym's day-to-day operations, which is why features like login and authentication are not active in this environment.
items.info: The project's API is hosted on Render's free tier, which spins down the application after a period of inactivity. If you encounter an error or no data loads when accessing the pages, simply wait a few seconds and refresh the page (or try navigating again) until the API turn on and returns the items. NOTE: The Node.js backend repository is private, but the code can be shared upon request.

items.title: ApodFlow
items.description: A space exploration app that consumes NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) API. Featuring a fluid, immersive interface inspired by TikTok, the project presents astronomical images and facts in an engaging format. The platform also includes a date search filter, allowing users to easily discover which photo was highlighted by NASA on their birthday, for example.

items.title: Estuda Enade
items.description: Work done with a friend from college, I was responsible for the FrontEnd and he for the BackEnd. It is a website about Enade, an evaluation test for students in higher education. The site aims to help students prepare for the exam by offering study materials, simulations, and preparation tips.

items.title: Old Portfolio
items.description: My old portfolio, developed before learning Next.js and other modern technologies. It was created using pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, without the use of frameworks or libraries. The design is simple and functional, it is responsive but has some limitations in terms of usability. This project helped me learn the fundamentals of web development and motivated me to seek more advanced knowledge to create a more modern and efficient portfolio.
